messages.subject: Instruction — interlock failure analysis, Excelon EX-450 (Calverton)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Iqbal,

We act for Calverton Industries in an HSE investigation following a serious injury on a thread-rolling cell. We would like to instruct you to examine cell CR-TR-12 (Excelon EX-450) and report on: (a) how the guard interlock came to be defeated; (b) whether the arrangement meets BS EN ISO 14119 against reasonably foreseeable defeat; and (c) whether the defeat would have been apparent on inspection.

The report should be addressed to this firm and marked as prepared for the dominant purpose of anticipated proceedings. Site access can be arranged via Neil Tasker. Are you available to attend next week?

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Instruction — interlock failure analysis, Excelon EX-450 (Calverton)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Happy to assist and available Thursday 9 April. From your description this sounds like the classic spare-actuator defeat on an older tongue-and-slot interlock — I'll confirm on examination. Please ask Mr Tasker to leave the cell undisturbed and to retain any spare actuators from the maintenance store.

Faisal Iqbal
Wraysbury Materials & Engineering Laboratory
